title: Smiling Children on Fiberglass Cow Statue, 1966 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white 1966 snapshot capturing a group of young school-aged children posing cheerfully on and around a large life-sized cow statue on a grassy lawn. Several children sit atop the cow's back while others stand beside it, dressed in mid-1960s casual attire, including pattern dresses, shorts, and polo shirts, reflecting mid-century American childhood and outdoor leisure.
